flagged.evidence: The Statement requires only a vector-space structure and norm for which “the constant sequence embedding i:X→X̂ is a dense linear isometry”; it never requires the new norm metric to equal the published completion metric. For X=c_00 with the supremum norm and its published completion c_0, choose a Hamel-basis linear automorphism A of c_0 that fixes c_00 pointwise and sends some basis vector outside c_00 to twice itself. Then N(u):=||Au||∞ is a Banach norm on c_0, agrees with ||·||∞ on c_00, and c_00 is N-dense because A[c_00]=c_00 and c_00 is ||·||∞-dense. Thus the same i is a dense linear isometry for N, but N differs from the published norm. Step 3.2 silently adds the missing condition by supposing “a second compatible Banach-space structure.”
